question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle ABC is 22.2 cm. What is the area of triangle (in cm² )?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the equilateral triangle = Perimeter ÷ 3 = 22.2 ÷ 3 = 7.4 cm

Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × (side)²

Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 7.4 × 7.4 = 13.69√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 13.69√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of the equilateral triangle ABC = 22.2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of an equilateral triangle = 3 × a

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

where a is the side length.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × a = 22.2

⇒ a = 22.2 ÷ 3 = 7.4 cm

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 7.4 × 7.4

⇒ Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 54.76

⇒ Area = 13.69√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 13.69√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Properties

All three sides and angles are equal, with each angle measuring exactly 60°.

Height of an Equilateral Triangle

The altitude h can be calculated directly using the side length with the formula h = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Inradius and Circumradius

The inradius r = a ÷ (2√3) and the circumradius R = a ÷ √3, providing the specific standard relation R = 2 × r.
